outcome: Redefine Oracle as an infrastructure-owned runtime Context Intelligence Plane: Core requests semantic context through an explicit requirement seam, Oracle resolves bounded context from governed providers, and Application/domain authority remains outside Oracle.
currentProblem: The previous BB-060 premise reduced Oracle to extracting two concrete IO loops and explicitly rejected runtime resolution, retrieval lifecycle and generic context semantics. New efficiency and context-grounding evidence makes that premise stale: ExHarness needs semantic code retrieval, graph-backed context assembly, provenance/currentness mapping and bounded runtime resolution without moving application control into Oracle.
constraints: Oracle remains infrastructure-owned outside Agentic Application and Core implementation packages, with acyclic dependency direction.
Application/domain controllers retain work semantics, acceptance, publication, recovery and product authority.
Core may request and consume resolved context but must not own source-specific retrieval, provider catalogs or Oracle planning.
Retain valid prior findings about physical ownership, sourceRef/provenance and fail-closed source handling; supersede the assumption that two concrete pull functions are the final Oracle boundary.
Do not select a context-graph, search/LSP or persistence technology before primary-source inspection and a discriminating experiment.
Research must define a benchmarkable runtime boundary before Worker authority can be restored.
successCriteria: Research specifies the runtime path Application semantic need -> ContextRequirement -> Core runtime -> Oracle -> governed providers/planner -> ContextResolution.
Physical package ownership and compile-time dependency direction are mechanically testable and keep Oracle outside Application/Core implementation ownership.
Retained findings and superseded assumptions from the prior BB-060..064 readiness cycle are explicitly recorded.
At least two relevant retrieval/context approaches are compared from primary sources; public GitHub examples meet the 1,000-star evidence rule when used.
A falsifiable prototype and benchmark handoff are defined so the next READY plan does not rely on architecture prose alone.
